name: record-scaffolding-merge-limits
body: Three limits. (1) The merged files map is unioned and never pruned against the manifest, so a path deleted in an earlier scan can keep a later-retired module alive until a full-scan extraction replaces the record. (2) A pure-intermediate module with no files entry whose only parent module is retired survives as an orphan module with no parent edge until a full scan re-extracts; upgrade if the retirement walk must cascade through the stored Module-to-Module tree or prune stale file paths. (3) `record` reads the delta baseline `State` through a separate store open before it opens its write transaction, because loading while the write transaction holds `facts.lock` would self-contend for the bounded budget; upgrade to a `FactStore`-taking `State::load_from` if the store ever forbids same-process double-open.
